name: GLM Coding Plan (Z.ai) via Claude Code
plans: GLM Coding Plan Lite / Pro / Max
strengths: Cheap high-volume coding on a separate quota.

install.windows: get a key at https://z.ai and set the ZAI_API_KEY user environment variable

notes: Untested by the maintainers. Runs the claude binary against Z.ai's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, so it spends the GLM quota, not Claude's. The key is read from the environment only; never put it in this repo. Use the /api/anthropic endpoint: the OpenAI-compatible one does not draw down the plan.
